intent: Count how many of 6 specified product variants are not available today at the Brno Veveri store.
success_criteria: Resolves each of the 6 SKUs by brand + model + property filters
Counts SKUs whose available_today_quantity is 0 or have no inventory row at that store
Answer is exactly the integer count in '%d' format

args.stdin:
WITH target_store AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM stores
  WHERE city = :store_city AND store_name LIKE :store_name_like
  LIMIT 1
),
targets AS (
  SELECT v.product_sku,
         (SELECT property_value_text FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'tool_type') AS tool_type
  FROM product_variants v
  WHERE v.brand = :p1_brand AND v.model = :p1_model
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'tool_type' AND p.property_value_text = :p1_tool_type)
)
SELECT v.product_sku FROM target_store LIMIT 1;

WITH target_store AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM stores
  WHERE city = :store_city AND store_name LIKE :store_name_like
  LIMIT 1
),
matched AS (
  SELECT v.product_sku FROM product_variants v
  WHERE v.brand = :p1_brand AND v.model = :p1_model
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'tool_type' AND p.property_value_text = :p1_tool_type)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.product_sku FROM product_variants v
  WHERE v.brand = :p2_brand AND v.model = :p2_model
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'machine_type' AND p.property_value_text = :p2_machine_type)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.product_sku FROM product_variants v
  WHERE v.brand = :p3_brand AND v.model = :p3_model
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'screw_type' AND p.property_value_text = :p3_screw_type)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'diameter_mm' AND p.property_value_number = :p3_diameter_mm)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.product_sku FROM product_variants v
  WHERE v.brand = :p4_brand AND v.model = :p4_model
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'fitting_type' AND p.property_value_text = :p4_fitting_type)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'diameter_mm' AND p.property_value_number = :p4_diameter_mm)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'connection_type' AND p.property_value_text = :p4_connection_type)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.product_sku FROM product_variants v
  WHERE v.brand = :p5_brand AND v.model = :p5_model
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'garment_type' AND p.property_value_text = :p5_garment_type)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.product_sku FROM product_variants v
  WHERE v.brand = :p6_brand AND v.model = :p6_model
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'adhesive_type' AND p.property_value_text = :p6_adhesive_type)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unavailable_count
FROM matched m
LEFT JOIN store_inventory si
  ON si.product_sku = m.product_sku
  AND si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM target_store)
WHERE COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) = 0;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
